prompts: Use case: ads-marketing. Create one finished portrait Instagram carousel slide, 4:5 aspect ratio. Brand Pelagia, a scuba dive logging and sharing web app. Premium editorial underwater photography, deep navy #080b10, electric blue #48a6ff, subtle turquoise, crisp white Avenir-style sans serif type. Refined spacious typography, very readable on phones, generous 90px safe margins. Full bleed realistic ocean photograph with dark gradient behind text. Consistent small 'Pelagia' wordmark top left, slide number top right. No fake UI, no invented logos, no watermark. Slide 01 / 04. Exact text: top left 'Pelagia'; top right '01 / 04'; small eyebrow 'MEET PELAGIA'; large headline across upper-middle 'Log your dive.\nFind your buddy.'; small bottom line 'Your underwater stories start here.'; bottom right 'Swipe →'. Elegant typographic hierarchy. Output a single slide.
